purpose: First conservative local-support classification experiment and 100 deterministic offline trial attempts, not a validated mobility system
rawData: 294 original pose-matched processed Koivu depth frames; no confidence/tracking invented
rules: Retain global coordinates and all original observations. Saved valid Open3D planes are estimators only; invalid fits supply no floor explanation.
Floor support exists only in a cell with actual near-surface endpoints within 2 mm of a valid per-view plane in at least three views.
Support height is the median observed supporting endpoint height, not extrapolated plane height. More than 2 cm inter-view height spread is unresolved.
An elevated residual above 5 mm in at least two views blocks; any other positive residual above 2 mm remains unresolved, never floor-cleared.
A negative residual below -2 mm remains unresolved support/drop evidence. A fit cannot erase a toy, step or hole.
Compare actual per-cell support heights across observed neighbours; retain discontinuities exceeding 5 degrees plus 2 mm quantization allowance per endpoint as step edges.

Upper-body/head occupied and unknown cells remain checked in original world-coordinate OctoMap states at threshold 0.5, relative to local support. Existing split-0.7 high obstacles/unknowns are also retained.

Observed-free, occupied and unknown remain separate. Raw observations with invalid fits or beyond 4 m do not create new floor support. Existing raw/fused hazards remain unless individually explained as observed floor.
These strict residual thresholds are experimental resolution requirements, not measured accuracy claims. Failure does not justify widening them after seeing routes.
No camera-path carving, new similarity scale, FARO correction, body shrinking or margin reduction. A compact column collision map is an adapter, not a new SLAM or search algorithm.

trialSelection.method: Select starts deterministically from baseline split-0.7 cells that fit the unchanged body+margin, before reading corrected classification. Pair with sufficiently separated baseline-fit goals around the fixed geometric centre where possible. Do not select from reference geometry or camera trajectory.
trialSelection.planner: Pinned Recast/Detour 9f4ce64458dfae86e1239c525ddc219c4e9e06f1; conservative single circumscribed body circle plus unchanged 0.15 m margin; actual rectangle checked for movement
trialSelection.simulation: Deterministic nominal pose/body integration, not live localization or a claim of realistic human compliance
trialSelection.reference: Separate evaluator only after planner artifacts are frozen; no reference-derived planning input. If no valid start survives, score admission failures without inventing reference movement outcomes.
